Google Sign-In Setup

How to configure OAuth 2.0 Credentials

💡 You don't need Google keys to test the app! You can click "Continue as Guest" or use standard email registration anytime.

To enable real Google Sign-In with your Google Account:

  1. Open Google Cloud Console and create or select a project.
  2. Go to APIs & Services → OAuth consent screen and select External. Fill App Name and support email.
  3. Go to Credentials → Create Credentials → OAuth client ID.
  4. Select Application type: Web application.
  5. Add Authorized JavaScript origin: http://localhost:5000
  6. Add Authorized redirect URI: http://localhost:5000/api/auth/google/callback
  7. Copy your Client ID and Client Secret into your .env file: 
    GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID=your-client-id.apps.googleusercontent.com
GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET=your-client-secret
